title: ESAOG: reference implementation, SOST benchmark and experimental results
description: Reference implementation of the Executable Semantic Agent Orchestration Graph (ESAOG; architecture v1.1), the SOST v1.0.1 benchmark (192 instances; SHA-256 b8c7e4be6832142d16343cc3b115506533000af7aecde26d15f4a0b8c6ba8e80), ontology modules and SHACL shapes, raw results of all reported experiments, analysis scripts that regenerate every table and figure of the accompanying manuscript, and the literature-review evidence matrix. Code: MIT; data: CC BY 4.0.
